name: SplitText-TS-TW
title: SplitText
blurb: Characters or words animate in staggered fashion when scrolled into view.
description: Uses GSAP SplitText to split text into characters, words, or lines and animate them from a starting state to an ending state with configurable stagger. Triggered by ScrollTrigger on scroll visibility.
use_when: Headings or body text need a polished staggered reveal that's synchronized to scroll.
avoid_when: When text must be immediately readable or when rapid scrolling should not trigger the animation.
a11y: Text is split into character/word/line elements and animated. Fully readable; animation is purely visual.
